title: arabis glabra
intro: Arabis glabra, commonly known as Tower Rockcress or Sticky Rockcress, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Brassicaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues due to its therapeutic actions, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties. The bioactive constituents of Arabis glabra include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its health benefits, such as antioxidant, antiproliferative, and immunomodulatory activities. The plant's extract has been shown to exhibit potential in the prevention and treatment of various diseases, including cancer, cardiovascular disorders, and microbial infections.
